metadata.title: Non-Pseudo-Arithmetic Hyperbolic 4-Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We give three explicit finite-volume hyperbolic Coxeter lattices in dimension four whose adjoint trace fields are not totally real. They are the reflection groups of the Ma--Zheng polytopes $P_{11,6}$, $P_{11,7}$, $P_{11,8}$. The obstruction is contained in two cyclic products of the doubled unit-normal Gram matrix $A=2G$. Those products recover elements $s=\sqrt5$ and $u$ satisfying $$ (s-1)u^2+2(s-3)u+s-7=0. $$ After the embedding $s\mapsto-\sqrt5$, this quadratic has discriminant $8(1-\sqrt5)<0$. The cyclic-product field therefore has a complex place. Vinberg's identification of that field with the adjoint trace field and the Emery--Mila total-reality obstruction imply that the three lattices are not pseudo-arithmetic. Torsion-free orientation-preserving finite-index subgroups yield orientable noncompact finite-volume hyperbolic $4$-manifolds with the same obstruction. Exact computations check the census data and provide independent field and finite-volume certificates. A pinned Lean~4 development verifies the radical identity and the number-field obstruction. It also checks the lattice and manifold implications conditional on explicit geometric and literature hypotheses.

analysis.progressType: 非伪算术双曲四流形的显式构造
analysis.workSummary: 研究Ma–Zheng三个四维有限体积Coxeter多胞体P₁₁,₆、P₁₁,₇、P₁₁,₈的反射格。Gram矩阵的循环积恢复√5和满足指定二次方程的u，其共轭下判别式为负，故伴随迹域有复嵌入。
techniques: 双倍单位法向Gram矩阵循环积
精确算术证书与Lean 4形式化
analysis.breakthrough: 由迹域非全实推出三个格非伪算术，进而取无挠保向有限指标子群，得到可定向非紧有限体积双曲四流形。
analysis.limitations: Lean部分验证根式恒等式与数域阻碍，对格与流形的推论明确以几何及文献输入为假设。需区分计算认证和这些外部输入。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 双曲四流形的算术性阻碍明确，值得阅读几何构造和形式化范围。
